name: Hitsuji-kun nara Kiss Shite Ageru ☆
original_name: 羊くんならキスしてあげる☆
source:
Within a sweeping mansion in a picturesque town lives two children, the primary school kid Houjou Katsuki and her teenage butler Nagahara Hitsuji-kun. The master and mistress of the house have disappeared long ago, leaving the two to fend for themselves.

Since the bread winners have gone, Hitsuji has to take care of both the tiny girl and the expenses in the house. When the funds are running low, an idea hit him. He is going to turn the mansion into a lodging house.

Become Hitsuji, take care of the young lady and get to know the charming girls who come to live under the same roof with you. With a flow like a graphic novel, this game is going to bring a flash of warm color this Spring.

[from [url=https://www.play-asia.com/hitsuji-kun-nara-kiss-shite-ageru/13/70376n]PlayAsia[/url]]
translation:
在风景如画的小镇里，一座宽敞的宅邸住着两个孩子：小学生北条香月，以及她的少年管家长原羊君。宅邸的主人夫妇早已不知所踪，只剩两人相依为命。

养家的人离开后，羊不仅要照顾年幼的小姐，还要负担家中开销。资金快要用完时，他想到了一个办法：把宅邸改成寄宿屋。

扮演羊，照顾小姐，并认识那些搬来和你同住的迷人女孩。这款游戏将以图像小说般的节奏，为这个春天带来一抹温暖色彩。

[来源：[url=https://www.play-asia.com/hitsuji-kun-nara-kiss-shite-ageru/13/70376n]PlayAsia[/url]]
